caption: The video captures an overcast seascape under a gray horizon, with a broad band of white foam rolling in the foreground. A surfer in a dark wetsuit is prone on a pale surfboard amid churning spray on the face of a breaking wave. The spray around the surfer thins as the surfer shifts upward from the board. The surfer pushes into a crouch, knees bent, while the wave steepens and breaks behind them. White water grows along the crest and spreads outward, carrying a frothy plume to the right. The surfer rises to a standing stance, arms extended for balance, and tracks along the open face. The board remains visible beneath the feet as the rider holds a balanced stance through the breaking section. The foreground foam and distant horizon stay largely fixed, keeping the visible action centered on the surfer's transition and the wave's ongoing break.
